## Summary

Implements the ADR 0156 benchmark campaign core: immutable plans, deterministic interleaving, exact preflight approval, persisted pause/resume identity, failure-preserving evidence, reproducible reporting, campaign execution identity in benchmark records, and host-only evaluator separation.

## Validation

Windows Validation is requested by the trusted dispatcher; AI Studio visual wiring follows as a separate request on the same Draft PR.
